basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) Recruitment Cell has notified 1 vacancy for the Consultant for Works Accounts Section post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply by email on or before 2 November 2026 after downloading the prescribed application form from the IIT Delhi website, filling it, affixing a recent passport-size photograph, and attaching self-attested copies of educational qualification and experience documents in PDF format. content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Consultant for Works Accounts Section at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) in any discipline with minimum 60% marks and 1 year post-qualification experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must mail the prescribed filled-in application form along with self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification and experience in PDF format (all scanned documents clearly legible, preferably at 300 dpi or higher) to [email protected] by 02.11.2026 . Hard copies sent through post or courier are not required.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Education Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade point average. Desired Education Qualification: Diploma or certification in Computer Applications, Advanced Financial Accounting, or related areas from a recognized institution. Essential Work Experience: Minimum 01 (One) year of post-qualification work experience in handling Works/ Accounts/ Finance/ Procurement matters in Central Government/ State Government/ Autonomous Bodies/ Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)/ Reputed Educational or Research Institutions. Age Limit: Below 35 years as of 02.11.2026. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form filled in by the candidate Recent passport-size photograph affixed on the application form Self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification (academic and professional) Self-attested copies of documents supporting work experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received within the due date will be shortlisted by a Committee. The prescribed essential qualifications and experience are minimum, and mere possession does not entitle any candidate to be called for interview. If a large number of applications are received, IIT Delhi reserves the right to conduct a Shortlisting/Screening Test. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, the date of which will be intimated separately through email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for the IIT Delhi Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is 02.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis initially for a period of 01 year, which can be extended up to a maximum of 03 years subject to requirement and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit and cut-off date for determining it?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years, and the cut-off date for determining age, experience, and educational qualification is 02.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted by a Committee. If a large number of applications are received, IIT Delhi reserves the right to conduct a shortlisting or screening test to restrict the number of candidates for the next round.

faq.question: Q5. What documents need to be attached with the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach the filled-in application form with a recent passport-size photograph along with self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification and work experience in PDF format.
